name: unique_id
description: Donor identifier from the source export. Kept as text so prefixes and leading zeros survive.

name: receipt_no
description: Receipt number from the source export. Kept as text so leading zeros survive.

name: age
description: Donor age in years. NULL when the source value is 0 (unknown) or outside the valid range; see age_status.

name: age_raw
description: Age exactly as supplied, before validation. Kept so the age rule can change without a re-load.

name: age_status
description: valid | unknown (source value 0 or blank) | out_of_range (negative or above the valid maximum).

name: donation_amount_2019
description: Total donated in calendar year 2019, in SGD (assumed currency; confirm).

name: donation_amount_2020
description: Total donated in calendar year 2020, in SGD (assumed currency; confirm).

name: donation_amount_2021
description: Total donated in calendar year 2021, in SGD (assumed currency; confirm).

name: donation_amount_2022
description: Total donated in calendar year 2022, in SGD (assumed currency; confirm).

name: donation_amount_2023
description: Total donated in calendar year 2023, in SGD (assumed currency; confirm).

name: donation_amount_2024
description: Total donated in calendar year 2024, in SGD (assumed currency; confirm).

name: donation_amount_2025
description: Total donated in calendar year 2025, in SGD (assumed currency; confirm).

name: donation_amount_2026
description: Total donated in calendar year 2026, in SGD (assumed currency; confirm).

name: _source_row
description: Row number in the source sheet (header is row 1), for tracing a value back to the export.

name: _load_id
description: Load batch identifier; matches gp_audit.load_log.load_id and the landing-bucket folder.
